tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Consultants/firms/organization shall ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date of bid submission.
Consultants/firms/organization shall ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date of bid submission.
Consultants/firms/organization shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs.
Conditional Request for Proposal will not be accepted.
Any discrepancies observed in the documents uploaded by the Consultants/firms/organization , the Request for Proposal shall liable to be rejected.
Earnest Money Deposit will have to be in any one of the forms as per the instructions in the financial bid document and shall have to be valid for 45 days beyond the validity of the tender.

All the formats prescribed in the bid documents shall be filled in complete manner and shall be uploaded properly, signed by Consultants/firms/organization. Necessary certificates shall be uploaded along with the formats wherever required. General documents section can be used for this purpose.
Consultants/firms/organation are required to read the Bid Documents carefully before submission of their bid.
Consultants/firms/organation are required to read the Bid Documents carefully before submission of their bid.
All other Terms and conditions are applicable as per the Request for Proposal
The Consultants/firms/organation shall submit FINANCIAL PROPOSAL SUBMISSION FORM ,SUMMARY OF COSTS,BREAKDOWN OF COSTS only after opening of Financial bids to the Employer.
Consultants/firms/organization shall secure a minimum Technical score of 75 points to Qualify

The Quality Supervision Consultant (QSC) must have their own laboratories with accreditation of NABL firms with NABL accreditation for testing construction materials as the scope of work also includes testing of materials to be used by the contractors. The details of the laboratories, equipment and testing facilities should be furnished by the QSC.
Consultant will be selected under Quality- and Cost-Based Selection (QCBS) procedure

The Technical Proposal shall not include any financial information other than the specified technical criteria in the RFP. Bid will be treated Technically Non Responsive if technical proposal includes any financial submission forms.

To qualify for the award of the Project Management consultant Services, each consultant/firm in its name should have in the last 5 years i.e. (2021-22 to 2025-26) achieved at least in two years a minimum annual financial turnover of Rs.112.00 Lakhs from Project Management Consultant Services Only. The Annual financial Turnover Certificate and certified copies of IT returns, audit report, profit and loss statement etc., balance sheet, shall be issued by the registered Chartered Accountant (The financial Turnover of the previous financial years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to 2026-27 price level)
The Amount/ rates put to tender are exclusive of GST & inclusive of all other applicable taxes
Stipulated Period of completion is till completion of the project

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Specific experience of the consultants related to the Assignment :To qualify for the award of the Project Management consultant Services, each consultant/firm in its name should have in the last 5 years i.e., (2021-22 to 2025-26) achieved at least Two similar type of building works Minimum Project cost Rs. 3761.50 Lakhs The completion certificate should have been issued by not below the rank of Executive Engineer of Government, Semi Government or Autonomous bodies of State or Central Government. Note For Each similar type of completed assignment 10 points is allocated. Points for the similar type of Assignment allocated as follows Hospital Building Assignment 2*10 Points 20 points Other Building Assignment 2*5 Points 10 points
Qualifications and competence of the key professional staff Qualification 20 points Experience to related project 22 points Experience in region and language 08 points Total Points 50
Adequacy of the proposed work plan and methodology

Laboratory should possess all the requirements of Civil works as per standards, preferably with NABL Accreditation (Chemical Mechanical and electrical) -The firm that does not have own laboratory can have the MOU with the firm or institution, having NABL with in Karnataka State only. Note, Own Laboratory With NABL Accreditation, 20 points. MOU with the firm With NABL Accreditation 10points,
